sourceSentences: At maximum stacks, his next basic ability consumes them all to become empowered with an additional effect and grant him an additional cast along with movement speed for 1.5 seconds.
Rengar can cast any of his abilities during the dash.
Rengar can freely use any abilities, summoner spells, or item actives while leaping. Using a dash or blink ability will interrupt the leap.

The attack from the leap will: Not go off if the dash was interrupted. Go off at the end of the dash even if its normal destination is obstructed by boundaries he cannot cross (e.g. terrain). Go off regardless of distance the enemy travels away from Rengar's original location. Go off even if Rengar loses sight of the target.
While grounded or rooted, Rengar loses the enhanced attack range from Unseen Predator.
Casting Savagery does not break stealth.
Attacking or casting abilities other than Savagery ends Thrill of the Hunt immediately.
If Rengar casts Savagery and/or Battle Roar during Bola Strike's cast time, he will buffer them and cast them when Bola Strike completes.
Rengar stores 50% of the post-mitigation damage he has taken in the last 1.5 seconds as grey health on his health bar, increased to 100% of damage taken from monsters.
Ferocity Bonus: Battle Roar's damage is modified. Rengar cleanses himself from all crowd control.
Ferocity Bonus: Bola Strike's damage is modified. The target is rooted instead of slowed.
(3 Minute, auto-translated) Your initiation combo: attack, E, W, and Q, followed by another E to immobilize the target while retreating. You can use E while jumping in the air.
(3 Minute, auto-translated) Your combo for damage: initiate with an attack in E and Q, then instantly a second Q, continuing to attack with tremendous speed.
